name: wechat-mcp
description: WeChat (social): me, publish_text, read_comments, delete. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_wechat_appid.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WECHAT_APPID
platform_mcp_wechat_appid.description: AppID of the Official Account (服务号 / 公众号), sent with the AppSecret to GET https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/token?grant_type=client_credential (https://developers.weixin.qq.com/doc/service/api/base/api_getaccesstoken); the calling server's IP must be on the account's API IP whitelist (errcode 40164 otherwise).

platform_mcp_wechat_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WECHAT_SECRET
platform_mcp_wechat_secret.description: AppSecret of the Official Account. The returned access_token (7200 s) travels as the access_token query parameter of every call; fetching a new one invalidates tokens held by other servers of the same account.

tools.name: me
tools.description: The Official Account API has no 'who am I' call: getApiDomainIp (GET /cgi-bin/get_api_domain_ip) verifies that the AppID / AppSecret mint a working access_token and returns {ip_list} of WeChat API servers.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: PUBLISHES TO ALL FOLLOWERS: sendAll {filter: {is_to_all: true}, msgtype: 'text', text: {content}} submits a mass-send (群发) job to every follower of the Official Account; it consumes the account's limited mass-send quota (errcode 45028 'has no masssend quota') and, with API 群发保护 on, waits up to 30 minutes for an administrator's confirmation. Success means the job was accepted, not delivered. `id` is msg_id (the send task id). `reply_to` is ignored. No clientmsgid is sent, so WeChat dedupes identical content to the same audience within 24 h by its own digest.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: listComment {msg_data_id (`post_id`: the numeric msg_data_id returned when an ARTICLE (mpnews) was mass-sent, not the msg_id of a text send), begin, count (<50), type: 0 (ordinary + selected comments)} for the first article of the send. Verified accounts only (88000 'without comment privilege'). created_at is a Unix timestamp; the account's reply sits under raw.reply; author is the commenter's openid (absent for non-WeChat identities).

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: deleteMassMsg {msg_id, article_idx: 0} invalidates the body of ALL articles of that API mass send ('该字段不填或填0会删除全部内容'); followers keep the message card. Only article (mpnews) and video sends can be deleted - '其他类型的消息一经发送，无法删除', so a text publish_text cannot be withdrawn (errcode 40008 / 40065).
